.github/workflows/android.yml.text:
name: Android Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App Version (留空使用默认)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      compile_experimental:
        description: '使用 COMPILE_EXPERIMENTAL (默认开启)'
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App Version'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      compile_experimental:
        description: '使用 COMPILE_EXPERIMENTAL'
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean

env:
  HAXE_VERSION: 4.3.7
  HXCPP_COMPILE_CACHE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.hxcpp_cache

jobs:
  build:
    name: Android Build
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@main
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set App Version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            sed -i 's/version="[0-9.]*"/version="${{ inputs.version }}"/' project.xml
            echo "APP_VERSION=${{ inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            DEFAULT_VERSION=$(grep -o 'version="[0-9.]*"' project.xml | head -1 | sed 's/version="//' | sed 's/"//')
            echo "APP_VERSION=$DEFAULT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
          echo "使用版本号: $APP_VERSION"

      - name: Setting up Haxe
        uses: krdlab/setup-haxe@v2
        with:
          haxe-version: ${{ env.HAXE_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Android NDK
        id: setup-ndk
        uses: nttld/setup-ndk@main
        with:
          ndk-version: r25c

      - name: Restore Previous Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: cache-build-android
          path: |
            ~/.gradle
            .haxelib/
            /home/runner/haxelib/
            /Users/runner/haxelib/
            C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/haxe/4.3.6/x64/lib/
            ~/.haxelib/
            export/release/android/haxe/
            export/release/android/obj/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/haxe/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/obj/
            export\release\windows\haxe\
            export\release\windows\obj\
            .haxelib\
          restore-keys: |
            cache-build-android

      - name: Installing/Updating libraries
        run: |
          rm -rf ~/.haxelib
          haxelib setup ~/haxelib
          haxe -cp commandline -D analyzer-optimize --run Main setup -si

      - name: Configure Android
        run: |
          haxelib run lime setup -alias -y
          haxelib run lime config ANDROID_SDK $ANDROID_HOME
          haxelib run lime config ANDROID_NDK_ROOT $ANDROID_NDK_HOME
          haxelib run lime config JAVA_HOME $JAVA_HOME_17_X64
          haxelib run lime config ANDROID_SETUP true

      - name: Fix Haxelib
        run: |
          haxelib set lime git
          haxelib set hxcpp git
          haxelib set flixel git
          haxelib set flixel-addons git
          haxelib set flixel-animate git
          haxelib set hxdiscord_rpc git

      - name: Building the game
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.compile_experimental }}" == "true" ]; then
            haxelib run lime build android -final -D ONLY_ARM64 -D COMPILE_EXPERIMENTAL --app-version="${{ env.APP_VERSION }}"
          else
            haxelib run lime build android -final -D ONLY_ARM64 --app-version="${{ env.APP_VERSION }}"
          fi

      - name: Uploading artifact (entire build)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Codename Engine Android ${{ env.APP_VERSION }}
          path: export/release/android/bin/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*

      - name: Clear Previous Cache
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const caches = await github.rest.actions.getActionsCacheList({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
            })
            for (const cache of caches.data.actions_caches) {
              if (cache.key == "cache-build-android") {
                console.log('Clearing ' + cache.key + '...')
                await github.rest.actions.deleteActionsCacheById({
                  owner: context.repo.owner,
                  repo: context.repo.repo,
                  cache_id: cache.id,
                })
                console.log("Cache cleared.")
              }
            }

      - name: Upload New Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: cache-build-android
          path: |
            ~/.gradle
            .haxelib/
            /home/runner/haxelib/
            /Users/runner/haxelib/
            C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/haxe/4.3.6/x64/lib/
            ~/.haxelib/
            export/release/android/haxe/
            export/release/android/obj/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/haxe/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/obj/
            export\release\windows\haxe\
            export\release\windows\obj\
            .haxelib\
          restore-keys: |
            cache-build-android

.github/workflows/ios-sim.yml.text:
name: iOS Sim Build
on: workflow_dispatch
env: 
  PROJECT_NAME: CodenameEngine
jobs:
  build:
    name: iOS Build
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@main

      - name: Setting up Haxe
        uses: krdlab/setup-haxe@v2
        with:
          haxe-version: 4.3.7
      - name: Restore Previous Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          # not caching the bin folder to prevent asset duplication and stuff like that
          key: cache-build-ios
          path: |
            ~/.gradle
            .haxelib/
            /home/runner/haxelib/
            /Users/runner/haxelib/
            C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/haxe/4.3.6/x64/lib/
            ~/.haxelib/
            export/release/android/haxe/
            export/release/android/obj/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/haxe/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/obj/
            export\release\windows\haxe\
            export\release\windows\obj\
            .haxelib\
          restore-keys: |
            cache-build-ios
      - name: Installing/Updating libraries
        run: |
          haxe -cp commandline -D analyzer-optimize --run Main setup -s
      - name: Fix Haxelib
        run: |
          haxelib set lime git
          haxelib set hxcpp git
          haxelib set flixel git
          haxelib set flixel-addons git
          haxelib set flixel-animate git
          haxelib set hxdiscord_rpc git
      - name: Building the game
        run: |
          haxelib run lime build ios -nosign -simulator

      - name: Make Ipa
        run: |
          cd export/release/ios/build/Release-iphoneos
          mkdir Payload
          mv *.app Payload
          zip -r ${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}.ipa Payload
          
      - name: Uploading artifact (entire build)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Codename Engine iOS
          path: export/release/ios/build/Release-iphoneos/*
      - name: Clear Previous Cache
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const caches = await github.rest.actions.getActionsCacheList({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
            })
            for (const cache of caches.data.actions_caches) {
              if (cache.key == "cache-build-ios") {
                console.log('Clearing ' + cache.key + '...')
                await github.rest.actions.deleteActionsCacheById({
                  owner: context.repo.owner,
                  repo: context.repo.repo,
                  cache_id: cache.id,
                })
                console.log("Cache cleared.")
              }
            }
      - name: Upload New Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          # caching again since for some reason it doesnt work with the first post cache shit
          key: cache-build-ios
          path: |
            ~/.gradle
            .haxelib/
            /home/runner/haxelib/
            /Users/runner/haxelib/
            C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/haxe/4.3.6/x64/lib/
            ~/.haxelib/
            export/release/android/haxe/
            export/release/android/obj/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/haxe/
            export/release/ios/${{ env.PROJECT_NAME }}/obj/
            export\release\windows\haxe\
            export\release\windows\obj\
            .haxelib\
          restore-keys: |
            cache-build-ios
